title: cydonia lagenaria
intro: Cydonia lagenaria, commonly known as the quince, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Rosaceae family. The health benefits of Cydonia lagenaria include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which may help protect against chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Cydonia lagenaria include its use as an anti-inflammatory agent and its potential to stimulate the digestive system. The bioactive constituents of Cydonia lagenaria include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
